# Five additional bank senders

`messages.json` preserves layouts observed on an authorized device. All names,
amounts, account/card suffixes, timestamps and security codes are fictional.
No private SMS exports belong in this repository.

The definitions route the exact observed senders only. Missing local account
identities, ambiguous transfers and incomplete financing evidence remain in
review. No suffix is padded and no ownership is inferred. A SAB payment
confirmation is informational, not a second payment. OTP, rejected operations
and EmiratesNBD installment reminders never post automatically.
